messages:
alex_support: Hi team — elevated from CS: customer ben_customer reports that after a recent tool rename their calls to the old name return a 404. Error: `ToolNotFound: 'TranslateText'`. They say this started immediately after we renamed the tool to `translate_text_v2` yesterday.
ben_customer: Repro steps I ran (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' 
 -d '{"tool":"TranslateText","args":{"text":"hello","to":"es"}}'
```
Response: 404 + JSON `{ "error": "ToolNotFound", "message": "TranslateText" }`. No SDK caching on our side, plain HTTP client.
alex_support: Thanks — can someone from runtime check registry mapping / alias propagation? Could be partial index update or cache TTL on the gateway.
maria_runtime: Looking. Initial guess: rename created a new tool UUID and the old alias was removed; our edge caches may still route by name but the registry mapping in region-us-west hasn't propagated yet. Asking infra to check registry sync jobs and the name->uuid index time.
sasha_support: Also asking customer if they're behind a corporate proxy or an API gateway that might be caching DNS or responses. @ben_customer any chance you have a reverse proxy or CDN in front of your client?
ben_customer: No proxy, just a simple service calling us-east instance. We also tried from a laptop (no prod network) and got same 404.
maria_runtime: I pulled the registry state for the global namespace: the canonical mapping now is `translate_text_v2` -> uuid: ttv2-uuid-123. There is no alias `TranslateText` present in the active alias table. However, I see a tombstone entry for the old alias (deleted) and the alias-backfill job is still queued. Edge cache TTL is 300s but some nodes haven't refreshed because they pulled at 10:02 and job completed at 10:04 -> small window where clients that hit stale nodes get 404.
alex_support: Ok. Two immediate paths: 1) create a short-lived alias `TranslateText` -> `ttv2-uuid-123` to unblock customer, or 2) advise customer to call the new canonical name `translate_text_v2` / upgrade SDK. Which is lower-friction?
maria_runtime: I'll create the alias for the tenant-scoped namespace (will expire in 24h). Doing it now, will post once it's live.
deploy-bot: alias-create event: tenant=ben-corp alias=TranslateText -> uuid=ttv2-uuid-123 ttl=86400s by maria_runtime at 1901122355
maria_runtime: Alias is created and propagated to control plane. Edge invalidation requests sent. Please test in ~30s.
ben_customer: Retested — calls now succeed, thank you! Response payload looks correct. :raised_hands:
alex_support: Great. Action items: runtime to follow up on why alias tombstone/backfill queue had delay; eng-infra to add a health metric for alias backfill latency; support to inform customer about the permanent name change and recommend setting up a short migration window for production. I'll file a follow-up ticket.
sasha_support: I'll draft a templated message for customers we renamed tools for in the last 48h to proactively avoid this. :memo:
maria_runtime: Follow-up note: we should also consider having the SDK casefold names and accept both kebab/camel/case variants for a short period post-rename to reduce friction. Filing internal RFC.
alex_support: Thanks all — closing this thread as resolved for the customer, leaving follow-ups for infra/runtime.
